title: Trials of a drug release platform in near-spherical porous NiTi alloys containing a thermosensitive hydrogel as the inner coating
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15639-15650
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01925G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zicheng Wan, Dongyang Li, Yang Zhou, Tun Wang, Benyin Zhu, Changhai Du, Yimin Li, Chang Shu
This study presents a preliminary investigation of porous NiTi scaffolds with controllable porosity via MIM-PSH, loaded with rapamycin thermosensitive hydrogel for in vitro drug release, SMC inhibition, and in vivo inhibition of intimal hyperplasia.
